ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a long solenoid, consisting of many closely arranged coils wound around the "Axis of solenoid" marked by a dashed line; the red arrow labels the current I, indicating that the same current flows along the wire winding. Reasoning: The question only asks how the magnetic field inside an ideal solenoid varies with the current I, and by default the geometry of the solenoid remains unchanged. method.method_draft: Read the image as a long coil/solenoid with many closely spaced turns around a dashed axis, with red arrows labeled I showing the same current through the winding. Read the text as asking only how the interior magnetic field depends on the current I, with the solenoid geometry held fixed. Use the ideal-solenoid result from Ampere's law, B = μ0 n I inside, where n is the turn density. Since μ0 and n are constant for the given solenoid, conclude that B is directly proportional to I.

method.method_draft: Read the image as showing many identical current-carrying loops making up a solenoid, all carrying current I around the common axis. Read the text as specifying an ideal solenoid and asking for the functional dependence of the internal field on I. Use linear superposition/Biot-Savart reasoning: the magnetic field produced by each current element or loop is proportional to the current in that element, and the total field inside the solenoid is the sum of the fields from all turns. With the number and spacing of turns fixed, multiplying I by any factor multiplies every turn's contribution by the same factor, so the total interior field scales by that factor. Therefore the magnetic field inside is proportional to I.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示一个由许多紧密排列的相同线圈组成的螺线管，中心有一条标为“Axis of solenoid”的虚线轴。导线上用红色箭头标出电流方向，并在导线和线圈附近标记电流为 I，表示各匝线圈都通有同一电流 I。

推理：理想螺线管可看作许多相同载流线圈的叠加。根据毕奥-萨伐尔定律，每一小段载流导线产生的磁场都与该段中的电流 I 成正比；每一匝线圈对内部磁场的贡献也与 I 成正比。螺线管的匝数和几何间距固定时，总内部磁场是所有匝贡献的线性叠加。因此如果 I 增大为原来的 k 倍，每一匝的磁场贡献也增大为 k 倍，总磁场也增大为 k 倍。所以螺线管内部磁场与 I 成正比。
method.model_answer: The magnetic field inside the ideal solenoid is proportional to the current I. Equivalently, for fixed turn density n, B = μ0 n I, so B ∝ I.
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer states that the magnetic field inside an ideal solenoid is proportional to the current I, matching the standard answer. The added formula B = μ0 n I for fixed turn density is correct and consistent.
